metaData.originalTitle: 首字延迟降低 3.6 倍，腾讯混元提出 Stem 稀疏注意力算法，长文推理加速新 SOTA
metaData.title: First Token Latency Reduced by 3.6x: Tencent Hunyuan Proposes Stem Sparse Attention Algorithm, New SOTA for Long-Context Inference Acceleration
metaData.oneSentenceSummary: Tencent Hunyuan proposes the Stem sparse attention algorithm, which, through two key innovations—Token Position Decay and Output-Aware Metric—approaches the accuracy of dense attention using only 25% of the compute. Combined with HPC operators, it achieves a 3.7x reduction in first token latency for 128K context, and has been accepted by ICML 2026.
metaData.summary: This article details the Stem sparse attention algorithm and its accompanying HPC operator optimization proposed by the Tencent Hunyuan team. It first identifies the performance bottleneck in the prefill phase of long-text inference, stemming from the quadratic complexity of Transformer self-attention, and analyzes the shortcomings of existing sparse attention solutions at both the algorithmic level (uniform budget allocation, ignoring Value information) and the operator level (high overhead of block skipping). The core innovations of the Stem algorithm include: Token Position Decay (TPD), which allocates more sparse budget to initial tokens based on their importance in the causal information flow; and Output-Aware Metric (OAM), which combines attention scores with the magnitude of Value vectors to more accurately select key tokens. At the operator level, HPC-Stem accelerates the evaluation and block selection process by tens of times through mathematical simplification, while HPC-BSA is designed for the Hopper architecture, enabling near-zero overhead block-level skipping. The article provides end-to-end test data on the Tencent Hunyuan Hy3 preview model, showing a 3.7x reduction in first token latency for a 128K context while maintaining model accuracy. The paper has been accepted by ICML 2026, and the related code has been open-sourced.

mainPoints.point: The Stem algorithm achieves near-lossless accuracy with only 25% of the compute through two key innovations: TPD and OAM.
mainPoints.explanation: TPD dynamically allocates the sparse budget based on the importance of tokens in the causal information flow, prioritizing initial tokens; OAM combines attention scores with the magnitude of Value vectors to more accurately select tokens that contribute significant information, rather than relying solely on scores.

mainPoints.point: HPC operators translate the theoretical speedup of sparse attention into actual hardware performance.
mainPoints.explanation: HPC-Stem accelerates the evaluation and block selection process by tens of times through mathematical simplification; HPC-BSA is designed for the Hopper architecture, placing block-skipping decisions upfront to achieve near-zero overhead block-level skipping, making latency linearly related to compute density.

mainPoints.point: The full-stack solution achieves a 3.7x reduction in first token latency for 128K context.
mainPoints.explanation: By integrating the Stem algorithm and HPC operators into the vLLM inference framework of the Tencent Hunyuan Hy3 preview model, end-to-end tests show a significant reduction in first token latency while maintaining model accuracy.

keyQuotes: The algorithm determines 'which computations to save,' and the operator determines 'how much faster the saved computations can be'—the two work in synergy to form a complete closed loop from theory to deployment.

The name 'Stem' is derived from the metaphor of a tree trunk—in the causal attention architecture, the tokens at the initial positions are like the trunk of a tree, supporting the transmission of all subsequent information.

relatedArticles.title: Making LLMs Understand 3,000 Years of Chinese Characters: Chronicles-OCR, a Benchmark for Ancient Chinese Character Recognition, Released
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Tencent Hunyuan, in collaboration with multiple institutions, released Chronicles-OCR, the industry's first benchmark for ancient Chinese character recognition covering seven scripts from oracle bone script to cursive script. Evaluating 28 mainstream multimodal large models, it found that even the strongest models nearly failed entirely at ancient character recognition, revealing that modern VLLMs heavily rely on modern layout priors and lack fine-grained stroke perception capabilities.

relatedArticles.title: The Evolution of Agent/Skills/Teams Architectures and Principles of Technology Selection
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article systematically reviews the evolutionary trajectory of AI Agents from monolithic to multi-agent, then to Skills pluginization and Teams parallel collaboration, and, drawing on the latest research from Google and Anthropic, provides a scientific methodology for selection.

relatedArticles.title: All-in-One Text, Image, and Video! An Open-Source Framework for Multimodal Knowledge Bases
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Tongyi Lab has open-sourced the VimRAG framework, which leverages Dynamic Acyclic Graphs (DAG) and Graph-Guided Policy Optimization to solve cross-modal retrieval and long-context reasoning challenges in mixed-media knowledge bases.

relatedArticles.title: Hy-Memory Launch: Building a Supercharged Second Brain for Agent Memory
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Tencent Hunyuan launches Hy-Memory, a memory plugin designed for Openclaw Agent, featuring a 6-layer memory framework, System1/System2 dual systems, and an evolution chain mechanism to address memory fragmentation, information loss, and cognitive iteration issues in long-term collaboration scenarios.

relatedArticles.title: Tencent Hunyuan Open-Sources New Translation Model Hy-MT2, Mini-Program 'Tencent Hy Translation' Now Available for Experience
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Tencent Hunyuan open-sources its next-generation translation model Hy-MT2, supporting 33 languages. The 7B and 30B-A3B models achieve state-of-the-art open-source results, while the 1.8B model surpasses mainstream commercial APIs. A mini-program and app of the same name have also been launched.

relatedArticles.title: MiniMax M3: Cutting-edge Coding, 1M Context, Native Multimodal — All in One Model
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: MiniMax releases the M3 model, integrating cutting-edge coding capabilities, 1M ultra-long context, and native multimodality, making it the first domestic model to combine these features, and it has been open-sourced.

relatedArticles.title: Essential for Travel! Tencent Hunyuan Open-Sources Offline Translation Model for Mobile, Only 0.4GB, Supporting 33 Languages
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Tencent Hunyuan has open-sourced an extremely quantized offline translation model for mobile, Hy-MT1.5-1.8B. Using 2-bit and 1.25-bit compression techniques, the model size is reduced to 440MB, supporting offline translation in 33 languages with quality surpassing Google Translate.

relatedArticles.title: LLM Training You Didn't Know: Principles, Paths, and New Practices - Tw93
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article systematically outlines the full-stack architecture of LLM training in 2026, providing an in-depth analysis of key technical decisions and engineering practices ranging from pre-training, data engineering, and post-training to Agent training and Harness optimization.

relatedArticles.title: AI R&D Automation: Wiki Knowledge Base + Skill Pack
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article details how to build a continuously growing team knowledge base and a supporting expert skill pack based on the LLM-Wiki model and the Obsidian platform to achieve AI-driven R&D automation.

relatedArticles.title: Tencent Hunyuan 3D World Model 2.0 Released: Seamless Integration with Game Workflows
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Tencent Hunyuan has officially open-sourced its 3D world model HY-World 2.0. This model can generate editable 3D assets with physical collision from text, image, or video input in one click, and seamlessly import them into game engines like Unity/UE, significantly lowering the barrier for creating game maps and level prototypes.
